limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter wrap but also made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed input acceptance on the first clock after reset, while the original kept `ready_a` low until that clock edge.
Gating `valid_b` with `valid_a` changed its timing when input stalls after five accepted bits; the original asserted it whenever the counter was at five.
The test exercised reset and stalls but expected the rewrite’s always-high readiness and sixth-bit-only valid pulse, so it could not catch either timing regression.
